policy.active_versions: One current validator, one current cross-object ruleset, one case list, one finite acceptance plan, one consolidated result summary.
policy.historical_iterations: Earlier prototype files, review reports, and change/handoff notes were distilled into 驗證/演進與驗收總結.md and removed from the active working tree. Git history remains available but is not required for ordinary handoff.
policy.source_paths: External original source paths are not modified by this consolidation.
policy.test_results: PASS only applies to the exact test performed; static checks never substitute for execution.
policy.research_modules: Research modules reuse the current data contract, compare against the read-only P1/P2 sources, and do not bypass the active acceptance gate or imply runtime validation.
policy.research_review_records: Static critique records are indexed but do not update the normative schema, acceptance status, or UI gate; runtime claims require execution evidence.
policy.research_scope_boundary: 本清冊只管理 AI 理解可視化與框架編輯介面課題；複雜系統解構、世界模型建構、因果閉環與模擬驗證屬獨立專門研究，可按任務需要提供方法支援，不構成平行認知核心，也不自動代表已整合進主體。
policy.human_interaction_layer: 圖形認知與固定引導流程是既有 AI 認知架構的人類使用者側延伸；允許獨立的視覺語法、互動狀態機與圖形表示模型，但語意變更須經版本化映射契約回饋核心。此層不替代機器認知核心，也不強制 AI 對所有任務採單一推理流程。

capabilities: Loads comparison baseline separately from current model; both stay in page memory
Compares nodes, edges, conditions and sources by unique non-empty ID within each collection
Classifies additions, removals, semantic top-level field modifications and presentation-only top-level changes

Missing or invalid IDs are retained as unknown identity; no index-based cross-version guessing

scope_limits: Direct adjacency only; not a complete recursive impact-propagation calculation

No schema validation, edit/writeback, persistence, publish or core integration
